label: pjm 92 ambient derate
definition: (PROBE) PJM 92 GT ambient-temperature capacity derate on the pjm-90 recipe: adds config.gt_ambient_derate (CC 0.4 %/C, CT 0.6 %/C above a 35 C net-summer reference x measured hourly zone tmax) — the physically-correct incremental hot-hour GT derate the EIA-860 net-summer rating omits. Rule-11 physical input (physics slope x measured temperature), forward-reproducible; NOT tuned to the residual. VERDICT vs pjm-90 keeper: essentially unchanged — C1 still FAIL (2024 CC_REGULAR +13.5 TWh, ST_GAS -8.0), C3c still FAIL (2025 2h vs 51h, up from 0h). Diagnostic conclusion: the summer scarcity tail is NOT a capacity leak. Measured net-summer already captures the summer ambient derate (incremental ~0.3 GW at peak), there are no phantom retirements/mothballs, and the energy+reserve co-opt cannot bind (deliverable reserve-supply cap ~48 GW vs ~3.3 GW measured Primary requirement — reserve is effectively ramp-unlimited). The tail is a price-formation/mechanism issue (Issue C: ramp-unbounded reserve supply + monthly gas smoothing daily heat-wave basis spikes), not overstated capacity — so the derate is kept as correct structure but does NOT recover scarcity. pjm-90 stays keeper. Otherwise the pjm-90 recipe verbatim.
